title: Rice & Moong Dal Usili
description: Ghee-roasted rice and moong dal pressure cooked with a crunchy dal and red chilli tempering.
ingredients: ¾ cup Moong dal (split yellow mung beans)
3 tbsp Urad dal (split skinless black gram)

steps.title: Roast grains
steps.text: Wash the rice and moong dal. Dry-roast in a pan until the excess water evaporates. Add 2 tablespoons of ghee and continue roasting until golden brown. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Tempering
steps.text: Heat 5 tablespoons of oil in a pan. Add broken dried red chillies, split chana dal, urad dal, asafoetida and coriander leaves; sauté until lightly browned.

steps.title: Prepare water mixture
steps.text: Add 4 ½ cups of water and 1 ½ teaspoons of salt to the tempering and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.text: Combine the boiling water mixture and the roasted rice-dal mixture in a vessel. Place the vessel inside a pressure cooker and cook for 3 whistles.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Allow the pressure to release naturally, stir well and serve hot.
